name: ashui
description: Native reactive UI for Haxe, with typed HXX, CSS, themes and animation.
releasenote: Runs in a page: blinc_abi builds as a wasm side module that ships in the release, with ashui's own page, a bundled default font, and Fonts and Assets for a program's own files. Redraws only the parts of a frame that changed, and a GPU error no longer ends a window. Canvases can retain what they built and give it back when idle. A wide tree builds about 30 times faster and a keystroke in a long document costs half as much. Expanded CSS and element coverage, visual inspection and input replay tools, and idle windows that sleep.
